stem: The volumes, in millilitres, of large and small cups of tea are modelled by the distributions $\text{N}(200, 30)$ and $\text{N}(110, 20)$ respectively.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Find the probability that the total volume of a randomly chosen large cup of tea and a randomly chosen small cup of tea is less than 300 ml.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Find the probability that the volume of a randomly chosen large cup of tea is more than twice the volume of a randomly chosen small cup of tea.
